references.text: This verse gives the original count of the tribe of Issachar, which is the same number (54,400) mentioned in Numbers 2:6.
The second census of the tribe of Issachar shows the change in numbers over time, which can be compared with the figure in Numbers 2:6.
The preceding verse identifies Nathanel son of Zuar as leader of the tribe of Issachar, whose army and numbered men are described in verse 6.
Nathanel son of Zuar is mentioned again as leader over the army of Issachar during the departure from Sinai.
The sons of Issachar who came to Egypt, showing the tribe's origin before it grew to the number recorded in Numbers 2:6.
